independent_package.limits: Identity/structure check only. Compiled bytes are not reproducibly compared to a local build. Does not execute runtime/browser gates or establish live EVE, Windows/DPAPI, actual OBS or extended-play acceptance.
independent_package.method: Independent archive safety, CRC and SHA256 verification; every eligible tracked file compared by Git blob ID against the exact Actions commit; copied public assets and compiled client references checked. Compiled bytes were not compared to a separate local build.

independent_review.package_and_verification: source_tooling_tests: accepted; separately compared all 576 Git source blobs and all 596 extracted ZIP members, reconstructed counts from raw hosted/local logs, and checked run/artifact/digest/phase identities.
independent_review.handoff_and_navigation: source_foundation: accepted; verified hosted identities/counts/versions and runtime summaries, source/tree identities, current local links, protected historical records and the boundary between ZIP contents and later handoff updates.
